name: ai-video-pricing
description: AI video cost per second from a dated, sourced dataset (Kling 3.0, Veo 3/3.1, Runway, Luma, Pika, Hailuo, Seedance, Higgsfield, UniqAI) plus a zero-dependency CLI that filters, sorts and recomputes dollars per second and per clip. Use for 'how much does AI video cost', 'cheapest AI video generator', or converting a plan's credits to dollars.
